response.sql:
WITH product_counts AS (
    SELECT p.product_id, COUNT(oi.order_item_id) AS item_count
    FROM Products AS p
    JOIN Order_Items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY p.product_id
), product_shares AS (
    SELECT product_id,
           item_count,
           1.0 * item_count / SUM(item_count) OVER () AS share
    FROM product_counts
), average_share AS (
    SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share
    FROM product_shares
)
SELECT SUM(ps.item_count) AS combined_count,
       AVG(ps.share) AS average_share,
       AVG(ps.share - av.avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM product_shares AS ps
CROSS JOIN average_share AS av
WHERE ps.share > av.avg_share;

assumptions.assumption: Products with no order-item lines are excluded, since the request counts products on order items; the share denominator and plain average therefore cover products that appear in Order_Items.

alternatives.interpretation: Include every product in Products, assigning zero count and zero share to products with no order-item lines.
